title: Nexus
visual_thesis: Nexus treats pretraining as a path through a landscape, not just a final loss number.
central_object: Two optimization paths moving across the same loss landscape.
primary_transformation: Equal final score becomes visibly different landing geometry, then task agreement reshapes the route.

scenes.viewer_question: How can two models tie on loss and behave differently downstream?
scenes.visual_object: two dots on one contour landscape
scenes.motion: Two colored paths descend to equal score lines but different basins.
scenes.meaning: The score hides where optimization landed.
scenes.caption: Two models can tie on loss and land in different basins.

scenes.viewer_question: Why does the landing place matter?
scenes.visual_object: the same landscape plus a downstream target valley
scenes.motion: One basin sits near the downstream valley while the other is far away.
scenes.meaning: Downstream tasks care about closeness, not just the pretraining score.
scenes.caption: Downstream tasks care which valley you are near.

scenes.viewer_question: What is Nexus trying to encourage?
scenes.visual_object: task direction arrows from the same model point
scenes.motion: Task arrows rotate from conflict into agreement.
scenes.meaning: Nexus wants task directions to pull the model toward compatible regions.
scenes.caption: Nexus asks whether task directions agree.

scenes.viewer_question: How does the method estimate that agreement?
scenes.visual_object: a model block, clone, mini-batches, and displacement arrow
scenes.motion: The model clones, steps on batches, and turns the displacement into g_hat.
scenes.meaning: Temporary inner motion becomes the training signal.
scenes.caption: Clone, step on batches, then measure the displacement.

scenes.visual_object: the same route through the landscape
scenes.motion: The route glows while the scorecard fades back.
scenes.meaning: The path through training is the object Nexus changes.
scenes.caption: Nexus changes the route, not just the score.
